criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies option pool size conflict between documents
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo Issue 6 and conflict matrix identify Term Sheet 2,000,000 ('15% of post-money') vs Minutes 1,500,000 (15% x 10,000,000 pre-money).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends using 2,000,000 share pool figure from term sheet
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo drafts to the controlling Term Sheet and recommends the board adopt the Plan reserving 2,000,000 shares, noting the 1,500,000 approval does not satisfy the closing condition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Certificate uses 2,000,000 share option pool
criteria_results.reasoning: The Certificate references the 2025 Equity Incentive Plan only in the Exempted Securities definition and never states a 2,000,000-share pool or reservation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Verifies 20,000,000 authorized Common is sufficient
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 10 verifies 10,000,000 + 2,000,000 + 3,333,333 = 15,333,333 against 20,000,000 authorized Common, leaving 4,666,667.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes limited headroom for future issuances
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo states the 4,666,667 headroom but presents it as sufficient (enough for a conversion price drop to about $1.50); it does not say headroom may be limited for future rounds or suggest increasing authorized Common.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies side letter full ratchet anti-dilution conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says no side letter is in the file and never identifies a full ratchet request for Aldersgate in conflict with broad-based weighted average.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Flags Delaware uniform-rights-within-series problem
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo notes that stock terms must be in the charter and would apply to all Series A shares, but it does not discuss full ratchet for Aldersgate only or the need for a separate sub-series under the Delaware uniform-rights rule.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends resolution for full ratchet conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo only recommends obtaining the side letter and confirming there is no bilateral understanding; it proposes no rejection, Series A-1 or contractual resolution of a full ratchet request.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Certificate uses broad-based weighted average anti-dilution
criteria_results.reasoning: Certificate Subsection 4.4.4 uses the broad-based weighted average formula CP2 = CP1 x (A+B)/(A+C), not full ratchet.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies liquidation preference conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 7 and the matrix contrast the Term Sheet's 1x non-participating greater-of with the Minutes' 1x participating capped at 3x ($10.80).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Recommends non-participating structure per term sheet
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo drafts the non-participating structure per the Term Sheet and calls for corrective resolutions for the Minutes.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Certificate drafts non-participating liquidation preference
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 2.1 provides the greater of 1x the $3.60 OIP plus declared but unpaid dividends, or the as-converted amount; 2.2 is non-participating.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies phantom redemption provision in board minutes
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 8 identifies the Minutes' fifth-anniversary redemption, absent from the Term Sheet and withdrawn by Aldersgate on 1/14 according to the emails.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Recommends excluding redemption from Certificate
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo excludes optional redemption (Subsection 6.1 states the shares are not redeemable), citing the withdrawal in negotiations and its absence from the Term Sheet.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Certificate does not include redemption rights
criteria_results.reasoning: The Certificate still contains a bracketed Subsection 2.3.2(b) holder-requested redemption after a Deemed Liquidation Event, which is a redemption provision for the Series A.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006a: Certificate states dividends are non-cumulative
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 1.1 says the dividends are 'non-cumulative' and 'shall not be cumulative'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006b: Certificate states dividends payable only when declared by Board
criteria_results.reasoning: Dividends are 'payable when, as and if declared by the Board of Directors'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006c: Certificate states dividends do not accrue if not declared
criteria_results.reasoning: 1.1 states that no right accrues by reason of dividends not being declared or paid in any calendar year.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Memo discusses non-cumulative dividend drafting risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo covers the greater-of construct and notes the conflict with the Minutes' 'whether or not declared' language, but it does not discuss drafting the non-cumulative clause to avoid an implied obligation to declare or pay.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Certificate preserves statutory class voting rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 3.3 requires Requisite Holder consent 'in addition to any other vote required by law or this Certificate of Incorporation'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Memo discusses DGCL § 242(b)(2) statutory class vote
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 242(b)(2) comes up only for the Common class-vote opt-out; the memo does not discuss the Series A protective provisions as supplementing the statutory class vote.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008a: Certificate includes vacancy-filling provisions for designated director seats
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 3.2 provides that each class fills vacancies in the directorships it elects.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008b: Certificate includes removal mechanics for designated directors
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 3.2 says class-elected directors may be removed without cause only by the electing class.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Memo flags missing vacancy/removal provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo discusses the Independent Director mechanics and deadlock but does not flag that the source documents omit vacancy, removal or default-selection mechanics.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies IPO auto-conversion threshold discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 12 notes the Term Sheet's $12.00 '(at least 3x)' against 3x $3.60 = $10.80.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Recommends resolution for IPO threshold discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo calls $12.00 the better reading of the signed text, drafts it in brackets, and recommends getting client instructions and confirming in writing with Ashford Gray.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Certificate states one consistent IPO conversion threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 5.1 states one operative threshold of [$12.00]; $10.80 appears only in the explanatory NTD.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Certificate includes exculpation clause covering officers
criteria_results.reasoning: Article VII exculpation covers directors '[or officer]', with the officer language included in brackets.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Memo discusses officer exculpation under amended DGCL
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 21 discusses officer exculpation under 102(b)(7) since August 1, 2022 and recommends including it (bracketed).

criteria_results.title: Certificate states Original Issue Price of $3.60 per share
criteria_results.reasoning: Subsection 1.3 sets the Series A Original Issue Price at $3.60.

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes 8% dividend rate for Series A Preferred

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes initial 1:1 conversion ratio

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes automatic conversion upon qualified IPO

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes automatic conversion by 60% holder consent

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes voting rights on as-converted basis

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes protective provisions for Series A Preferred

criteria_results.title: Certificate specifies 5-member board composition

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes exculpation provision under DGCL § 102(b)(7)

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes indemnification provision

criteria_results.title: Certificate includes corporate power provisions
